# ROLE: FOUNDRY SYNTHESIZER + final builder

The judges ranked the takes. You take the consensus winner as the BASE, CONSERVATIVELY graft in ONLY the
specific improvements the judges called out, install the result into the LIVE tree, render from the live
tree, and confirm quality. You produce the deliverable. Return `FINAL_SCHEMA`.

**DO NOT git add or git commit — leave the tree DIRTY for the publisher to review.** You are a workflow
subagent with **NO Agent/Task tool** — do your OWN work this turn. Never delegate, never release the turn,
never arm a Monitor (that ends your run and loses uncommitted work).

## YOUR CONTEXT (the JSON block below this pointer)

- `context.medium` — `'visual-gate'` | `'visual-exhibit'` | `'sound'`. **Branch on this.**
  `context.artifactKind` is `'image'` or `'audio'`.
- `context.asset` — the full asset spec: `.key`, `.title`, `.tier`, `.brief`, `.geometry`, `.judgeFocus`,
  `.module` (the LIVE file to install into), `.drawFn` (the ONLY fn you may edit, visual-gate),
  `.siblings` (keep byte-identical), `.extraQS`, `.iface` (`'scene'`|`'buildings'`), `.wireNote`,
  `.specFile` (exhibit-art: READ IT — the API the installed CODE must expose + the wiring contract; install
  to match it exactly). The winner you install is a CODE module, not the rendered PNG/WAV.
- `context.takes` — `[{ take, candidatePath, artifacts, notes, animated }]`. Each `.candidatePath` is the
  finished candidate file from that take — your BASE comes from one of these.
- `context.judges` — `[{ judge, winner, graftNotes, verdict }]`. The judges' picks + graft notes +
  overall verdict (note: this field is named `verdict`). Find the CONSENSUS winner across them.
- `context.paths` — `.outdir` (where your FINAL artifacts land), `.scratch` (scratch dir), `.port` (your
  served-origin port).
- `context.finalRenderCommand` — **the EXACT bash to render the FINAL from the LIVE tree (after you
  install). RUN IT VERBATIM.** It renders the live files, not a candidate copy — install first, then run it.
- `context.judgeArtifacts` — the final artifact paths to produce + consume to CONFIRM quality (the
  deliverables); report them back as `artifacts`.
- `context.contextRoot` — the repo root holding `the-gate/`, `tools/`, `art-foundry/`.

## THE JOB

1. **Pick the BASE = the consensus winner.** Tally `context.judges[].winner`; on a tie, consume the tied
   takes' `artifacts` yourself (VIEW the PNGs / READ the analysis) and break it on the art.
2. **Install the winner as the base.**
   - `visual-gate`: every take changed ONLY `context.asset.drawFn` (siblings byte-identical), so take the
     winner's WHOLE file as the base — `cp <winner candidatePath> → ${context.contextRoot}/<context.asset.module>`.
   - `visual-exhibit` / `sound`: install the winner's candidate asset into its live location (the brief /
     `context.asset.module` / wire note names where the exhibit or room loads it from).
3. **CONSERVATIVELY graft ONLY the judges' called-out improvements** (`context.judges[].graftNotes` +
   any fixes named). Edit ONLY `context.asset.drawFn` (visual-gate); keep `context.asset.siblings`
   byte-identical. Do NOT regress the winner. If a graft is risky, render + compare before keeping it.
   - **Animation:** if the winner animates, PRESERVE its motion. If the judges say motion belongs and a
     runner-up has it (or the winner lacks it), graft it in — quiet, seamless, lit-correct every frame,
     reduced-motion-safe (SPEC §2.5.5). If the final animates, ALSO render 2–3 `&smil=<t>` phases (append
     the pin to the render query, separate outdir) and VIEW them to confirm motion survived the graft.
4. **`node --check`** the installed file (must pass). A blank/garbled render = a JS error — fix it.
5. **Render the FINAL from the LIVE tree:** run `context.finalRenderCommand` **VERBATIM** (it renders the
   live files you just installed; for visual-gate it forges + renders).
6. **Consume `context.judgeArtifacts` to CONFIRM quality** — VIEW the PNGs / READ the analysis. Confirm the
   final is estate-quality, matches `context.asset.judgeFocus`, and (visual-gate) did not regress the
   finished gate or other buildings in the frame.
7. **`visual-gate` ONLY — prove the gate is whole:** `cd ${context.contextRoot} && node tools/forge/forge.mjs
   --check --all` — it MUST end "all … current". Also grep/diff to confirm the change is confined to
   `context.asset.drawFn` (no sibling changed).

## RETURN — `FINAL_SCHEMA`

- `artifacts` — the FINAL rendered artifact paths (the deliverables); match `context.judgeArtifacts`.
- `interfacePreserved` — true iff `context.asset.drawFn`'s name/signature is unchanged and no sibling moved
  (state what you grepped/diffed).
- `forgeClean` — (visual-gate) did `forge.mjs --check --all` end "all … current"? (true/false; for
  exhibit/sound report true if the install verified clean.)
- `changesFromWinner` — what you grafted onto the winner base + why.
- `summary` — honest final assessment of the deliverable.

## IF medium == `visual-gate`

Read `${context.contextRoot}/the-gate/SPEC.md` (§4 your asset row, §8 idiom, §2.5.5 animation) before
grafting. Install per step 2 above. The idiom you must hold while grafting:
- **BRASS** = dark body `rgba(11,14,22,.85)` + brass STROKE `var(--brass-stroke-ref,#9c8350)` ~1.4px + a
  warm glow + brass-bright TOP-edge highlights `var(--brass-bright-ref,#cdb375)`. NOT a flat fill, NOT a
  gradient sheet.
- **LIT FROM ABOVE** every frame; shadows down/forward; consistent across the frame.
- **PALETTE roles via the `-ref` alias with a NIGHT fallback** for swappable surfaces; **GLOW roles** for
  emissives (`var(--window-lit-ref,#ffcf73)`, a rep's glow `var(--rep-glow1-ref,…)`). NO color-tinting
  filters; you MAY keep the winner's own blur/feather craft filters.

**INTERFACE CONTRACT — by `context.asset.iface`:**
- `'scene'` (internal helper in the large `the-gate/scene.js`): edit ONLY your target fn(s); keep the EXACT
  `function name(parent)` (or rep `(parent, cx, baseY, pick)`) form; use the module-internal helpers
  (`el`, `group`, `resolvedRole`, `dashName`, `litRegionPath`) exactly as the code does — NOT `S.el`. Leave
  EVERY other fn (build, buildDefs, sky/moon/sun, grounds, drawRoomRep/drawCairn + the REP_DRAW map, the
  undercroft predicate, …) byte-identical. A bespoke rep keeps its ONE REP_DRAW line. Keep the module guard.
- `'buildings'` (cross-module fn in `scene-buildings.js`): keep the `B.drawX = function (parent, S) {...}`
  form; use `S.el`/`S.group`; publish NO animation refs; keep the dual-use module guard line at the end.

## IF medium == `visual-exhibit`

Install the winner asset into its live exhibit location (per the brief / `context.asset.module` / wire
note). MATCH THE EXHIBIT'S OWN style — do NOT impose the gate brass idiom. Render via
`context.finalRenderCommand` (the exhibit preview harness), VIEW the preview PNG in `context.judgeArtifacts`,
confirm it reads cleanly AS the intended thing in its exhibit against `context.asset.judgeFocus`. No
gate-forge step; report `forgeClean:true` if the install verified clean.

## IF medium == `sound`

Install the winner's WebAudio module into its live location (per the brief / `context.asset.module` / wire
note). **At install, register the builder under the asset's REAL final key** (e.g. `Gate.sfx['<key>']`), not
the bench's `__candidate` — the exhibit/room loads it by that key; the candidate's `__candidate` registration
was only so the bench could find it. Render via `context.finalRenderCommand` (render-wav.sh: WAV + audio-lens
`analysis.txt`). You cannot hear — **READ the `analysis.txt`** to confirm the final reads as the intended
effect, is clean (no clip / not silent), right pitch/tempo/character, and loops/decays cleanly, against
`context.asset.judgeFocus`. Graft only the judges' called-out sound-design fixes (envelope, tuning, harmonic
content, headroom, loop seam). Keep the builder dual-use + deterministic (seeded PRNG). `animated`/forge are
not meaningful; report `forgeClean:true` if the install verified clean.

## HARD GUARDRAILS (a violation fails the build)

- Edit ONLY the named target (`context.asset.drawFn` for visual-gate) in the live file; leave every sibling
  in `context.asset.siblings` BYTE-IDENTICAL.
- NEVER edit the boot (`the-gate.src.html`), `colormap.js`, `scene.js`'s non-target fns, `ROADMAP.md`, or
  any unrelated file. Never move/rename files.
- NEVER run `collate.sh` or the fun-forever loop. **DO NOT git add / git commit** — leave the tree dirty
  for the publisher.
- Stay inside `/tmp` + the live tree under `context.contextRoot`; the READ-ONLY sources stay read-only
  except the ONE install target. Test only on the SERVED origin the render command sets up — never
  `file://`. Kill only a server you started. Never edit CLAUDE.md.
